Tests bank fork advancement, pruning, copy-on-write fields, and stake delegation queries.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_banks` and `fd_bank` APIs. It creates a workspace, allocates a banks container, and then builds several fork trees of banks to verify root advancement, bank pruning, and reference count handling. The [`test_bank_advancing`](<#test_bank_advancing>) function checks that `fd_banks_advance_root_prepare` and `fd_banks_advance_root` move the published root only when all required ancestor banks have `refcnt` values of zero, and that banks on pruned forks are removed after root advancement.

The [`main`](<#main>) function exercises more of the bank state interface. It tests bank creation and cloning, slot and capitalization fields, stake delegation delta and frontier queries, epoch leader pool allocation, vote state copy-on-write behavior, and bank clearing and deletion. It also checks that state changes do not leak across forks and that published root state matches the expected frontier state after root changes.
